expected_symptom: Compiling the reporter's RWTexture2DMS shader for SPIR-V (-spirv -T ps_6_7 -E PS) fails while the identical shader compiles fine for DXIL.
history: always-repro'd across v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607 (19 stable releases; v1.4.1907 invalid-probe, SPIR-V codegen not built)
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Still reproduces on main as a real crash (chained LLVM asserts in clang::spirv::PreciseVisitor::isAccessingPrecise, exit 0xE0000001), not merely an unimplemented-feature diagnostic; continuing past both asserts (emulating Release/NDEBUG) shows DXC's own SPIR-V validator then rejects the malformed module it just built. All 19 probeable stable releases v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607 hit the same invalid-SPIR-V path and fail the same way without crashing (assert compiled out), so this has never worked in SPIR-V on any checkable release -- not a regression.
title: [SPIR-V][SM6.7] Add support for RWTexture2DMS in the SPIR-V backend
